ability.text: At the start of the round: You may spend any number of resources. Choose 1 skill (WIL, INT, COM, or AGI). For each 2 resources spent, get +1 to that skill until the end of the round.

signatures.name: The Fixer
signatures.text: Permanent. The Man in Black deck only. Unique. [action] Exhaust The Fixer: Fight. You get +2 <com> for this attack. This attack deals 3 damage. After you defeat an enemy with The Fixer: Gain 2 resources.

signatures.name: Cash in the Bag
signatures.text: Permanent. The Man in Black deck only. Unique. At the start of your turn: Gain 1 resource.

signatures.name: Sneaky Pete
signatures.text: The Man in Black deck only. Revelation — Take 2 horror. Spawn Sneaky Pete at your location. While Sneaky Pete is in play: You cannot gain resources from any source. When Sneaky Pete is defeated: Remove Sneaky Pete from the game.

deck.name: The Saturday Night Special
deck.text: Uses (4 ammo). [action] Spend 1 ammo: Fight. +1 COM. +1 damage.

deck.name: Old Habit
deck.text: [action] Exhaust + take 1 horror: Heal 2 damage from any investigator at your location.

deck.name: It's Time
deck.text: +1 AGI and +1 INT while in play. [free] End of round: Heal 1 horror from yourself.

deck.name: Big Tommy
deck.text: +1 AGI. 3/0 soak. [reaction] When you would take damage from enemy attack: Exhaust Big Tommy — he takes it instead.

deck.name: Old Man Winters
deck.text: +1 WIL. 2/2 soak. [reaction] When you would take damage or horror: Exhaust Old Man Winters — he takes it instead.

deck.name: Point Blank
deck.text: If successful while fighting: Deal +1 damage.

deck.name: Arkham Underground
deck.text: Fast. Choose asset you control with uses (ammo, secrets, or charges). Fully replenish uses to starting value.

deck.name: Lights Out
deck.text: [action] Fight. +1 COM. Each enemy at your location takes 2 damage. You take 1 horror.

deck.name: Not My Problem
deck.text: Fast. Cancel effects of a non-weakness treachery just drawn. Take 1 horror.

deck.name: Casing the Joint
deck.text: [action] Investigate using AGI instead of INT. If succeed: Discover 1 additional clue.

deck.name: Trap Door
deck.text: Fast. Automatically evade an enemy engaged with you. That enemy remains exhausted until end of next round. Move to a connected location.

deck.name: I Know A Guy
deck.text: Search your deck for any Asset and play it, reducing cost to 0. Shuffle your deck.

deck.name: Pray for Me Father
deck.text: Uses (4 supplies). [action] Spend 1 supply: Choose an investigator at your location to heal 1 horror. Then that investigator tests WIL (2). If succeed: Heal 1 additional horror.
